root_only_scope: No neural branch chosen in these two pairs; kept in formal aggregate. Small timing differences there are not policy gains.
notes: All 80 solves have known-optimum cutoff proof, no incumbent, and no open nodes. The original MILPs were not proved infeasible; no optimal feasible solution was produced.
SCIP native PDI is supplementary under the cutoff-only setting and is not evidence of feasible-solution discovery or directly comparable with MILP-L difficult-instance PDI.
All four shards ran sequentially according to timestamps, not concurrently; same CPU model, allocation and A100 model.
Paper already reports Mamba worse than relpscost on MILP-S. The best-neural-baseline claim cannot be tested without TreeGate/T-BranT etc.
Frozen test results are descriptive. No test-driven model selection or retraining was performed.
